blocks.raw: <Tip>Unlike sole proprietorships and partnerships, the corporate veil protects shareholders from personal liability for corporate debts beyond their investment. However, individual architects remain personally responsible for their own professional negligence — the corporate shield is not absolute for malpractice.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <ExamTip>The 75% RLA requirement applies to ALL classes of stock and voting arrangements. Non-architects may own up to 25% but CANNOT serve as directors or executive officers. This is a continuing obligation — the corporation must maintain compliance throughout its existence, not just at incorporation.</ExamTip>
